support_statement: PC9 keeps cycling under osimertinib, the DTP state is unexpectedly dynamic, and the time-course readouts document repeated EdU positivity and regrowth.
Low-dose ATM inhibition with AZD1390 reduces cell number, replication, and return-to-growth behavior in the PC9 DTP system.
Low-dose ATR inhibition with ceralasertib reduces DTP survival and shows the same DDR logic is not ATM-only.
manuscript_role: Shows the DDR logic extends beyond ATM

support_statement: The same dynamic DTP logic is reproduced in HCC4006, which makes the preprint useful as a second EGFR-mutant bridge.
